summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of FleetPro completed successfully. All 6 pytest backend tests passed and all 7 critical frontend flows (load, tabs, vehicle CRUD, damages with tolerated flow, maintenance schedule + alerts, handover with signature canvas, return) passed end-to-end.

issues: Stale handover protocols whose vehicle was deleted display as 'Unknown vehicle'. Backend cascades deletes for damages/schedules but not protocols, so orphan protocol cards remain. Consider also deleting protocols on vehicle delete OR hiding orphans.

action_items: (Optional) On DELETE /api/vehicles/{id}, also cleanup db.protocols for that vehicle to avoid 'Unknown vehicle' rows in history.
(Optional) Consider returning 201 status on POST creates for REST correctness (currently returns 200).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI; prefer lifespan handler.
create_handover blocks if vehicle status == 'on_road' but allows handover when status is 'damaged' or 'maintenance' - business logic decision; verify with PM if intentional.
Damage auto-sets status=damaged only if not already damaged/maintenance; tolerated damages never affect status (correct per spec).
Monthly maintenance alert uses calendar-month diff (year*12+month) rather than 30-day diff; acceptable but document.
All endpoints exclude _id properly. UUID-based ids used. Pydantic validation in place. CORS wide open via env (acceptable for preview).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_/TESTUI_ prefixed vehicles, damages, schedules and one handover+return cycle for verification. Some test data persists in DB for inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers dashboard stats, vehicle CRUD, damage tolerated/non-tolerated status flip, maintenance schedules+alerts+complete+history, full handover->return protocol cycle. Frontend Playwright flow verified: dashboard 4 stat cards, tab navigation, add-vehicle dialog, vehicles-subtab-damages with tolerated radio+confirm checkbox, add-schedule, handover-vehicle-select with signature canvas drawing via mouse events, proto-tab-history return-vehicle-{id} -> return-submit-btn turning card green with RETURNED badge. Toast shown 'Vehicle returned — status set to Parked'. One stale 'Unknown vehicle' history row observed from earlier test - design decision needed.
